cross_branch_contradictions_or_tensions.tension: Near-zero-latency incrementalism vs dense dependency closure
cross_branch_contradictions_or_tensions.resolution: Do not choose ideology. Preserve Delta semantics but make runtime recomputation strategy cost-adaptive; synthetic experiment shows closure approaches full graph at high density.

cross_branch_contradictions_or_tensions.tension: Hyperrelation-first representation vs simpler pairwise reductions
cross_branch_contradictions_or_tensions.resolution: Unlabeled pairwise is constructively insufficient for role identity, but typed role-labelled pairwise/state-machine reduction remains OPEN; promote native n-ary only on measured reduction/intervention error.
Treat as complementary layers. Capability answers who may act on what resource; IFC answers where protected data may flow after authorized reads.

cross_branch_contradictions_or_tensions.tension: Recurrent loop richness vs simpler event-pipeline explanation
